description: The AAS journals' class, AASTeX 7.0.1 (CTAN's copy, in case the mirror's snapshot predates it). Its preamble (round 2 of batch 1, GitHub run 41584963423) redefines three of the class's footnote macros, copied from the pinned aastex701.cls with two changes. (1) \make@footnotetext (l.527-541) adds \vadjust{\vskip\z@skip} after the footnote's last line only in horizontal mode. footnotehyper, which General's footnotes load, releases its saved notes through the class's \@footnotetext with \@makefntext, \@finalstrut and \rule emptied, so the \vadjust came after \unvbox in internal vertical mode: 'You can't use \vadjust in internal vertical mode' in every General footnote (F19: 1,547 not-denied branches, 1,179 failing on nothing else; 16 cells ended at TeX's 100-error stop). In horizontal mode, where every footnote of the class's own path ends, it is unchanged. (2) \@makefntext (l.7567-7569) and \@mpmakefntext (l.6209-6215, footnotes in floats and minipages) take paragraphs (\long), as the kernel's and revtex4-2's aps4-2.rtx \@makefntext do: General's block footnotes stopped at 'Paragraph ended before \@makefntext was complete' (F31: 596 branches; F49: 114 more, whose runaway argument ran to the end of the file). A footnote without a paragraph break sets as before.
